## Wave 3 Summary

Wave 3 advances the matter / neutrino sector along its two live openings. **W3-1** (`S99-E1-STAGE2-VERIFY`) promotes the §VII.BL E1 "Non-LI-Deformation Necessity" joint theorem one stage up the `joint-theorem-promotion.md` 4-stage pathway: the two columns of E1 — clause #7 (generation-blindness / ε_LX between-generation corridor) and clause #9 (baryogenesis uniqueness) — both PASSed their S98 columns (`S98-W3-1-YUKAWA-EPS-LX-BETWEEN-GEN` PASS, audit `b8487bc8`; `S98-W3-2-BARYOGEN-UNIQUENESS` PASS, audit `3be22b8a`), making E1 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE-eligible. W3-1 is the **Stage-2 two-agent PARALLEL cross-axis independent-verify**: two cross-reviewers on DIFFERENT axes (axis-A NCG `connes-ncg-theorist`; axis-B substrate `dirac-antimatter-theorist`), dispatched in parallel, NEITHER the original S98-W3-workshop author, NEITHER holding prior workshop context (dispatch prompts EXCLUDE the workshop transcripts — they read ONLY the registered §VII.BL E1 entry + the two input npz), with the JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd (logical AND, not OR). This is a `[VERIFY]` gate — NOT a workshop (no adversarial reading-divergence; it is a procedural promotion gate per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"`).

**W3-2** (`S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU`) computes the neutrino mass sum Σm_ν from the substrate type-I seesaw — the live matter-sector opening flagged by EVOI §1 rank-3 (Tier-1, HIGH), atlas-08 Q18b ("the seesaw route is the live opening"), and open-channel-ledger §B4 ("the only opening on the matter sector"). The direct-eigenvalue Rank-1 Yukawa route is a PROVEN wall (S62 `J_12/J_23 = 19.52` rank-deficient; re-confirmed by `S96-MATTER-R-HIERARCHY` FAIL, value 9.86 direct-eigenvalue spacing). The seesaw is register-sourced (NO S98 WP carry-forward); **its machinery is recovered substrate-first from the on-disk S96/S60 producing scripts** (`s96_matter_seesaw_d5.py` + `s60_lepto_cp_log.txt`) — not an external-paper placeholder, per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md`. The light masses follow from the type-I seesaw `m_i = Y_i² v² / (2 M_i)` with the right-handed Majorana texture M_R = the B-branch D_K fold energies (M_1 = 1.004396, M_2 = 1.078573, M_3 = 1.170003 M_KK; Majorana texture = the KO-dim-6 Pfaffian on H_K⁺ per `S96-MATTER-0NUBB`); Σm_ν is gated against the DESI 2024 cosmological bound Σm_ν < 0.072 eV (clean external laboratory-IN falsifier).

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S99-E1-STAGE2-VERIFY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PARTICLE"           # the joint theorem concerns the matter-sector representation content (generation multiplicity / ε_LX between-generation corridor + baryogenesis CP structure) of D_K; PARTICLE per phononic-framing classification guide (quantum numbers / selection rules / the representation-theoretic content of D_K).
agent_type: "connes-ncg-theorist + dirac-antimatter-theorist"   # TWO cross-reviewers, dispatched IN PARALLEL on DIFFERENT axes. axis-A (spectral / NCG-axiomatic) = connes-ncg-theorist; axis-B (substrate / Dirac-antimatter) = dirac-antimatter-theorist. NEITHER is the original S98-W3-workshop author (the S98 W3 columns were authored by neutrino-detection-specialist + the baryogenesis-side author); NEITHER holds prior workshop context. (Axis-B alternate: volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist, if dirac-antimatter-theorist fails the Axis-B Selection Protocol downstream-inheritance reach test.)
hypothesis: "The §VII.BL E1 'Non-LI-Deformation Necessity' joint theorem (column #7 generation-blindness / eps_LX between-generation corridor + column #9 baryogenesis uniqueness, both S98-column-PASS) holds at Stage-2: TWO independent cross-reviewers on DIFFERENT axes (axis-A NCG, axis-B substrate), neither the S98-W3 workshop author, neither given the workshop transcript, each independently PASS the JOINT clauses (PASS-AND, not OR), promoting E1 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE -> STAGE-3-PERMANENT."

method:
  description: >
    Stage-2 two-agent parallel cross-axis independent-verify per
    joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage 2 + the Axis-B Selection Protocol. Dispatch TWO
    cross-reviewers IN PARALLEL, each receiving ONLY (a) the registered STAGE-1-CANDIDATE
    §VII.BL E1 entry text from permanent-results-registry.md and (b) the two input npz
    (s98_w3_1_yukawa_eps_lx_between_gen.npz, s98_w3_2_baryogen_uniqueness.npz). The
    dispatch prompts EXCLUDE the S98-W3 workshop transcripts (the 'no prior workshop
    context' condition). Axis-A (connes-ncg-theorist, spectral / NCG-axiomatic) audits the
    axis-A-authored single-axis clauses PLUS the JOINT clauses; axis-B
    (dirac-antimatter-theorist, substrate / Dirac-antimatter) audits the axis-B-authored

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) — ALL required, ALL non-empty ----
#
# NON-COMPUTE gate (procedural Stage-2 promotion; two-branch PASS-AND adjudication, NOT a
# numerical-threshold comparison). Per the r3-yaml NON-COMPUTE gate note, items (2)/(3)/(4)
# take the N/A / false form with a one-word reason; the real PASS criterion is the PASS-AND
# logic pinned in (1) operator + the verdict rubric.

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "PASS iff ( axisA_single_axis_clauses == PASS ) AND ( axisB_single_axis_clauses == PASS ) AND ( for each joint clause c: verdict_axisA(c) == PASS AND verdict_axisB(c) == PASS ). Logical AND across both cross-reviewer verdicts; OR is FORBIDDEN."

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "ALL-CLAUSES-PASS-AND (both single-axis sets PASS in their respective reviewer; every JOINT clause PASS in BOTH reviewers)"
  direction: "="                      # set-equality on the PASS-AND predicate; not a scalar inequality (NON-COMPUTE adjudication gate)

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false                         # procedural-adjudication gate; the PASS criterion is the Stage-2 PASS-AND predicate from joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage 2, not an analytically-derived numerical threshold.
  proof_ref: "joint-theorem-promotion.md (Stage 2 PASS criterion: BOTH cross-reviewers PASS single-axis clauses; JOINT clauses PASS independently in BOTH verdicts, logical AND)"

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false        # the verdict space is the finite discrete set {PASS, FAIL, INFO} per cross-reviewer per clause; not a rational mesh (set-membership / two-branch adjudication).
  mesh_density: "continuous"          # N/A — discrete clause-verdict set; 'continuous' placeholder per the NON-COMPUTE gate note (no numerical mesh)

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "2"                         # TWO cross-reviewers (axis-A + axis-B), dispatched in parallel. The '2' is the structural floor: joint-theorem-promotion.md REFUSES single-agent (N_eval=1) firings on JOINT clauses.
  L_max: "12"                         # the S98 columns were both computed at L_max=12 (s98_w3_1 scheme L_max=12; s98_w3_2 L_max=12 baryogenesis); cross-reviewers verify against that truncation. No NEW diagonalization in this gate (it reads the two npz + the registered entry).
  scan_range: "N/A"                   # not a parameter scan; a two-reviewer clause-by-clause PASS-AND adjudication
  step_size: "N/A"                    # discrete clause-verdict adjudication; no step
  tolerance: "N/A — adjudication"     # clause verdicts are PASS/FAIL/INFO discretes, not numerical-tolerance comparisons (each cross-reviewer's per-clause numerical sub-checks carry their OWN tolerances inherited from the S98 column pins; this gate adjudicates the discrete clause verdicts)
  scheme: "STAGE-2-CROSS-AXIS-INDEPENDENT-VERIFY"   # the joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage-2 protocol scheme
  convention: "PASS-AND"             # JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd across both verdicts (logical AND, NEVER OR) — pinned per joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage 2
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "N/A — no linear algebra"  # the closeout reads two verdict fragments + applies the PASS-AND collapse; cross-reviewers' OWN sub-checks may use GPU but this closeout gate does not
  # --- gate-specific Stage-2 protocol pins (the substantive machinery) ---
  axis_A_reviewer: "connes-ncg-theorist (axis-A: spectral / NCG-axiomatic). Audits the axis-A-authored single-axis clauses + ALL JOINT clauses. Verifies the eps_LX between-generation generation-blindness (column #7) is an NCG-inner-fluctuation / external-non-LI structural fact (scheme NCG-INNER-FLUCT-EXTERNAL-NONLI, value=0.0) from the spectral side."
  axis_B_reviewer: "dirac-antimatter-theorist (axis-B: substrate / Dirac-antimatter). Audits the axis-B-authored single-axis clauses + ALL JOINT clauses. Verifies the baryogenesis uniqueness (column #9: eta_B in (0,6e-10), eps_nLI=eps_K7^2/n_pairs substrate-fixed NOT scanned, phi_CP forced pi/2) from the substrate / Dirac-antimatter side. ALTERNATE: volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist if dirac-antimatter-theorist fails the Axis-B Selection Protocol downstream-inheritance reach test (condition 2)."
  axis_B_selection_protocol: "ALL THREE conditions of joint-theorem-promotion.md Axis-B Selection Protocol MUST hold: (1) axis-distinctness — axis-B (substrate / Dirac-antimatter) is a DIFFERENT axis from axis-A (NCG-axiomatic / spectral); (2) original-authoring-agent exclusion WITH downstream-inheritance reach — neither reviewer is the S98-W3 workshop author NOR a successor whose memory inherits the workshop reading-path via reference_*.md re-citation of the S98-W3 transcripts; (3) audit-coverage adequacy — axis-B's domain expertise covers ALL JOINT clauses + ALL axis-B single-axis clauses. The orchestrator VERIFIES all three at dispatch; a downstream-inheritance-reach violation forces re-dispatch with an alternate same-axis reviewer of distinct lineage."
  joint_clause_enumeration: "The E1 joint clauses (from the registered §VII.BL E1 entry) carry per-clause author-side attribution: column #7 (generation-blindness / eps_LX between-generation corridor) is the spectral/Yukawa-side derivation (S98-W3-1, axis-A-leaning); column #9 (baryogenesis uniqueness) is the substrate/CP-side derivation (S98-W3-2, axis-B-leaning); the NON-LI-DEFORMATION-NECESSITY conjunction (that the Jensen non-Lorentz-invariant deformation is NECESSARY for BOTH generation-blindness AND baryogenesis uniqueness simultaneously) is the JOINT clause requiring PASS-AND. The cross-reviewers receive the clause-attribution map AS PART OF the registered entry (Stage-1 entries carry joint-clause flags + authorship attribution per joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage 1)."
  no_prior_workshop_context: "MANDATORY dispatch discipline. Each cross-reviewer's spawn prompt contains ONLY: (a) the registered STAGE-1-CANDIDATE §VII.BL E1 entry text from permanent-results-registry.md; (b) the two input npz paths (s98_w3_1_yukawa_eps_lx_between_gen.npz, s98_w3_2_baryogen_uniqueness.npz); (c) joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage 2 + the relevant rule-file references. The spawn prompt EXCLUDES the S98 W3 working-paper sections, the S98-W3 workshop transcripts, and any synthesis that re-narrates the workshop's reading-path. This breaks the shared-context-produces-shared-output failure mode (epistemic-discipline.md 'What Does NOT Count as Evidence' item 2): independent PASS from the registered entry alone IS evidence."
  pass_and_logic: "JOINT clauses are PASS-AND'd: composite PASS requires verdict_axisA(joint_c)==PASS AND verdict_axisB(joint_c)==PASS for EVERY joint clause c. ANY clause FAIL in EITHER reviewer -> Stage-2->3 promotion BLOCKED, E1 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE, FAILing clause routes to next-session remediation. ANY clause INFO in EITHER reviewer -> E1 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE, the INFO clause logged as Stage-2-INFO-deferred. Only ALL-PASS-AND promotes to STAGE-3-PERMANENT."
  substrate_input_orthogonality: "substrate-input-orthogonality predicate (joint-theorem-promotion.md): the two input npz are partitioned so that >= 1 npz is loaded by EXACTLY ONE cross-reviewer (NOT both) — s98_w3_1 (eps_LX, the spectral/Yukawa column) is the axis-A primary data; s98_w3_2 (baryogenesis, the substrate/CP column) is the axis-B primary data. This yields STRUCTURAL-INPUT independence (orthogonal data), the structural CEILING for the procedural-floor independence guarantee. If both reviewers genuinely need both npz for the JOINT clause, the Stage-2 PASS-AND carries the explicit 'substrate-input-overlap caveat' tag (status MANDATORY at K=3; under SUGGESTION the caveat is recorded, not blocking)."
  audit_machinery_not_self_authored: "joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage-2 audit item 6 (SUGGESTION K=1): if a cross-reviewer R applies a parse-tree decision procedure / 4-corner classification / cohomology bridge map AT THE VERDICT-EMISSION layer, R is NOT the sole author of that machinery. The two cross-reviewers here apply DISTINCT axis-native verification routes (axis-A spectral/NCG; axis-B substrate/Dirac), so neither is the sole author of the OTHER's verdict machinery — the cross-axis dispatch satisfies item 6 by construction."

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  BOTH cross-reviewers (axis-A connes-ncg-theorist, axis-B dirac-antimatter-theorist),
  dispatched in parallel from the registered §VII.BL E1 entry alone (NO workshop transcript),
  independently PASS their single-axis clauses AND every JOINT clause PASSes in BOTH verdicts
  (PASS-AND). Solution-space consequence: the §VII.BL E1 'Non-LI-Deformation Necessity' joint
  theorem is structurally robust under cross-axis independent verification; the agreement is
  structurally INDEPENDENT (neither reviewer saw the workshop), so it IS evidence per the
  joint-theorem-promotion.md constructive pathway. E1 promotes STAGE-1-CANDIDATE ->
  STAGE-3-PERMANENT; the orchestrator updates the permanent-results-registry.md §VII.BL E1 tag
  at session-end synthesis (mack-cosmic-bridge sole writer of the registry row if it is on the
  §7 falsifier surface; otherwise the registry-prose owner). The Jensen non-Lorentz-invariant
  deformation is established NECESSARY for BOTH generation-blindness AND baryogenesis uniqueness.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one cross-reviewer returns FAIL on at least one clause (a single-axis clause OR a
  JOINT clause). Solution-space consequence: Stage-2 -> 3 promotion is BLOCKED; E1 STAYS
  STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause routes to next-session remediation. The cross-axis
  independent verification surfaced a clause gap that the S98-column-internal verification (which
  had workshop context) missed — an informative constraint on the joint theorem's sufficiency
  conditions. (This is NOT an agent failure: a cross-review FAIL closes a corridor in the E1
  promotion path and is useful per math-scripts.md 'All Results Are Good Results'.)
INFO_meaning: >
  At least one cross-reviewer returns INFO on a clause (and NO clause FAILs in either reviewer).
  Solution-space consequence: E1 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is logged as a
  Stage-2-INFO-deferred item (documented, carried to next session). Also fires INFO if the
  substrate-input-orthogonality predicate FAILS (both reviewers needed both npz for the JOINT
  clause) -> the PASS-AND carries the explicit 'substrate-input-overlap caveat' and the
  structural-output-type independence is established but NOT the structural-input independence.
  The joint theorem is not yet STAGE-3-PERMANENT but no clause is refuted.
```

```yaml
    Majorana M_R gives LIGHTER m_nu (m_nu ~ m_D^2 / M_R) — so the substrate M_R ~ M_KK scale drives

    Step 1 (Definitions — cite canonical source / defining equation):
      m_{D,i}  = Dirac neutrino mass (i-th generation)
               = Y_i * v_ew / sqrt(2)                  [Dirac Yukawa; v_ew = 246 GeV, get_constant canonical_constants.py L2055]
      M_i      = right-handed Majorana mass (i-th)
               = (B-branch D_K fold energy) * M_KK      [M_1=1.004396, M_2=1.078573, M_3=1.170003 in M_KK units; s60_lepto_cp_log.txt; M_KK=7.42866e16 GeV get_constant]
      m_{nu_i} = light (active) neutrino mass (i-th)     [the observable feeding Sigma m_nu]
      type-I seesaw formula:  m_{nu_i} = m_{D,i}^2 / M_i = Y_i^2 v^2 / (2 M_i)   [S96 neutrino-detection-specialist synthesis canonical equation]

    Step 2 (Substitute the seesaw formula into Sigma m_nu, no simplification yet):
      Sigma m_nu = sum_i m_{nu_i}
                 = sum_i  m_{D,i}^2 / M_i
                 = sum_i  ( Y_i v / sqrt(2) )^2 / ( (B-branch fold energy)_i * M_KK )
                 = sum_i  Y_i^2 v^2 / ( 2 * (B-branch fold energy)_i * M_KK )

    Step 3 (Simplify — read the M_R dependence, one step per line):
      Hold m_D (numerator) fixed; vary M_i (denominator):
        m_{nu_i} = m_{D,i}^2 / M_i
        d m_{nu_i} / d M_i = - m_{D,i}^2 / M_i^2  <  0      [m_{D,i}^2 > 0, M_i^2 > 0 => derivative strictly NEGATIVE]
      Therefore m_{nu_i} is a STRICTLY DECREASING function of M_i:
        M_i  increases  =>  m_{nu_i}  decreases   (seesaw SUPPRESSION)

    Step 4 (Canonical form — the magnitude of the suppression):
      The suppression factor is m_{D,i} / M_i = (electroweak-scale Dirac mass) / (M_KK-scale Majorana mass).
      With m_D ~ O(EW) and M_R ~ M_KK = 7.42866e16 GeV, the ratio is ~ (1e2 GeV)/(1e16-1e17 GeV)
      ~ 1e-14 to 1e-15, so m_nu ~ m_D * (m_D/M_R) is suppressed FAR below m_D into the sub-eV regime.
      Numerically (S60 substrate values): Sigma m_nu = 0 + 0.008678 + 0.049528 = 0.058206 eV.

    Direction (read off the canonical form):
      d m_{nu_i} / d M_i < 0 (Step 3) => the seesaw SUPPRESSES; heavier M_R => lighter m_nu. The
      substrate places M_R at the M_KK scale (B-branch fold energies ~1.0-1.17 M_KK ~ 1e17 GeV), so
      Sigma m_nu is driven DOWN to 0.058206 eV < 0.072 eV (DESI). sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed
      Sigma m_nu - bound_DESI is NEGATIVE (Sigma below the bound), in the direction the suppression predicts.

    Conclusion:
      Sigma m_nu is the seesaw-SUPPRESSED image of the substrate D_K eigenvalues (m_D Dirac scale,
      M_R = B-branch Majorana scale). The suppression direction (heavier M_R => lighter m_nu) is
      strictly monotone-decreasing (Step 3), placing Sigma m_nu = 0.058206 eV below the DESI 0.072 eV
      bound => PASS. The substrate makes a PARAMETER-FREE Sigma m_nu prediction (m_D and M_R both
      substrate-derived); DESI is the laboratory-IN falsifier.
```

## Wave 3 → (downstream) Decision Point

Wave 3 has **no intra-session downstream consumer** (Waves 1/2/4 do not consume W3 outputs). Both gates' verdicts route to session-end synthesis and the forward registers:

### DP-W3-1 (E1 Stage-2 outcome → registry tag)

1. **What**: On `S99-E1-STAGE2-VERIFY` = PASS, promote §VII.BL E1 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT in `permanent-results-registry.md`; on FAIL/INFO, E1 stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE with the FAILing/INFO clause logged for next-session remediation.
2. **Who**: orchestrator at session-end synthesis (the registry-prose owner; `mack-cosmic-bridge` if the E1 row touches the §7 falsifier surface).
3. **Input**: the `S99-E1-STAGE2-VERIFY` verdict line + `s99_e1_stage2_verify.npz` (`e1_stage_transition`, `joint_pass_and`, per-clause verdicts).
4. **Output**: the updated §VII.BL E1 registry tag (STAGE-3-PERMANENT on PASS) OR the Stage-2-INFO-deferred / FAIL-clause-remediation note.
5. **Format**: `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` §VII.BL E1 entry (tag line); next-session carry-forward if FAIL/INFO.
6. **Deadline**: Session 99 session-end synthesis.
7. **Depends on**: `S99-E1-STAGE2-VERIFY` verdict line present in `computations/session-99/s99_gate_verdicts.txt`; the `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py` PASS (two parallel cross-reviewers, different axes, not workshop authors, no transcripts, JOINT PASS-AND) — a Stage-2-audit FAIL blocks the promotion regardless of the clause verdicts.

### DP-W3-2 (Σm_ν → canonical promotion + falsifier inventory)

1. **What**: On `S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU` landing a value, promote `Sigma_mnu_FW` to `canonical_constants.py` (Class 8.3 canonical write-order: verdict → canonical → inventory) and add the DESI Σm_ν falsifier row.
2. **Who**: `neutrino-detection-specialist` adds `Sigma_mnu_FW` + `Sigma_mnu_bound_DESI_2024` via `update_constant` (the value is its compute); `mack-cosmic-bridge` (sole writer per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`) adds the falsifier-inventory row.
3. **Input**: the `S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU` verdict line (full-64 audit_sha256) + `s99_w3_seesaw_summnu.npz` (`Sigma_mnu_eV` full float64).
4. **Output**: `Sigma_mnu_FW` + `Sigma_mnu_bound_DESI_2024` canonical entries (with provenance) + the DESI Σm_ν row in `falsifier-master-inventory.md`.
5. **Format**: `computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py` (`update_constant`); `sessions/framework/registry/falsifier-master-inventory.md` (mack row).
6. **Deadline**: Session 99 (in-session promotion per `math-scripts.md §"Canonical Write-Order"` — a single `update_constant` call, no sub-keying ambiguity ⇒ FIX-IN-SESSION).
7. **Depends on**: `S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU` verdict line present; `Sigma_mnu_eV` full-precision in the npz (round-trip per Class 8.3 item 3 — inventory cites the npz full float64, not the WP-rounded value).
